change_class_rationale: Two 2-line markdown additions to retired Tombstone runbooks. Adds the canonical body-level **Status:** + **Last verified:** blockquote markers required by oya-check-runbook-freshness#parse_runbook_freshness_record. No source semantics changed.
task: Resolve runbook-freshness gate failure surfaced by `oya verify --include-deferred`: MissingStatus on docs/runbooks/agentic-pipeline/grit-parallel-claim-demo.md. Root cause: the freshness kernel reads markdown body markers `**Status:**` and `**Last verified:**` (see crates/oya-check-runbook-freshness/src/lib.rs:60..76 and crates/oya-dev-cli/src/runbook_gates.rs:152..187), not YAML frontmatter. Both repo Tombstone runbooks had YAML `status: retired` but lacked the body-level markers. Add the canonical 2-line blockquote to both.
local_gates: runbook-freshness: PASS (was failing pre-edit with MissingStatus on grit-parallel-claim-demo.md; now 193 runbooks / 52 severity-scoped / 141 unscoped all valid)

findings: Two complete Tombstones share identical bug-shape. Fixed both in one slice rather than waiting for the gate to surface the second after the first lands — same change_id covers both. Kernel reads markdown prose, not YAML; the canonical sibling-runbook blockquote shape is reused verbatim (no new shape invented).

Edit is minimal-surface (2 lines per file, 4 lines total). Markers match the canonical body format already in use across 191 other runbooks (e.g. docs/runbooks/ad-auction-latency-incident.md, docs/runbooks/adr-promotion-triage.md). `**Last verified:** 2026-05-16` matches the ADR-0116 retirement date already cited in both files.
No data-class, no autonomy-ceiling, no licence surface touched. Tombstone semantics preserved — both runbooks still link to ADR-0116 as the authoritative replacement record.

Audit-chain row appended with distinct timestamp_unix + session_id (OP-08). Resolves a `oya verify --include-deferred` aggregator failure that was preventing clean 47/47-lanes-green state on origin/dev.

architect.rationale: Smallest correct fix. Adds the canonical markers from sibling runbooks; no new convention introduced; tombstone semantics intact.
